name: Sunbaked Terraces
description: Four camps on a dry Iberian hillside. No river runs here - the terraces are the map. Each camp looks out through a horned terrace wall with a gate at either horn, and the old press mound in the middle is high ground four worn tracks climb.
theme: Olives, dust, and four armies working out who owns the water.
